#!/bin/sh
# anthropic-shim runtime config — sourced by the service/superset before launch.
# Single-line JSON values only (this file is shell-sourced, do NOT put multi-line JSON).
# NEVER commit real keys.

export PORT="9086"
export UPSTREAM="https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions"
export UPSTREAM_UA="opencode/1.18.18 ai-sdk/provider-utils/4.0.23 runtime/bun/1.3.14"
export UPSTREAM_KEY="***REDACTED***"

# Provider API keys (rotation pools may be comma-separated; shim round-robins).
export DAHL_KEY="***REDACTED***"
export TOKENROUTER_KEY="***REDACTED***"
export BYNARA_KEY="***REDACTED***"
export GOOGLE_KEY="***REDACTED***"
export CLINE_KEY="***REDACTED***"
export CLINE_UA="Cline/3.0"
export GROQ_KEY="***REDACTED***"

# Tuning (adaptive timeout tracks observed baseline; these are the hard floors/caps)
export ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS="15000"   # floor per attempt (baseline*2+2s, clamped)
export TOTAL_BUDGET_MS="180000"     # whole-chain budget; adaptive ensures providers aren't falsely aborted
export COOLDOWN_BASE_MS="2500"      # exponential backoff base
export COOLDOWN_MAX_MS="30000"
export COOLDOWN_AUTH_MS="20000"
export SLOW_HEADER_MS="60000"        # latency cooldown effectively disabled (zen TTFB scales to 13-14s on heavy ctx and is still fastest; routing away never helps)
export MAX_BODY_BYTES="10485760"

# Default model (used for unknown/claude-* ids) — big-pickle@zen is primary.
export FALLBACK_MODEL="big-pickle"

# Providers (first = default). Free-tier models only.
export UPSTREAMS='{"zen":{"url":"https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/chat/completions","key":"$UPSTREAM_KEY","ua":"$UPSTREAM_UA","reasoning_param":true,"models":["big-pickle","nemotron-3-ultra-free","mimo-v2.5-free"]},"dahl":{"url":"https://inference.dahl.global/v1/chat/completions","key":"$DAHL_KEY","ua":"curl/8.5.0","thinking_param":true,"models":["moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6"]},"cline":{"url":"https://api.cline.bot/api/v1/chat/completions","key":"$CLINE_KEY","ua":"$CLINE_UA","models":["poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free","thinkingmachines/inkling:free","nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free","cohere/north-mini-code:free"]},"tokenrouter":{"url":"https://api.tokenrouter.com/v1/chat/completions","key":"$TOKENROUTER_KEY","ua":"curl/8.5.0","models":["qwen/qwen3.8-max-free"]},"bynara":{"url":"https://router.bynara.id/v1/chat/completions","key":"$BYNARA_KEY","ua":"curl/8.5.0","models":["agnes-2.5-flash","stepfun-3.7-flash"]},"google":{"url":"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/chat/completions","key":"$GOOGLE_KEY","ua":"curl/8.5.0","models":["gemini-3-flash-preview","gemini-3.1-flash-lite","gemini-3.5-flash","gemini-3.5-flash-lite","gemini-3.6-flash","gemini-3.7-flash","gemma-4-26b-a4b-it","gemma-4-31b-it"]},"groq":{"url":"https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions","key":"$GROQ_KEY","ua":"curl/8.5.0","models":["groq/compound-mini","openai/gpt-oss-20b","qwen/qwen3.6-27b","allam-2-7b","groq/compound","openai/gpt-oss-safeguard-20b"]}}'

# Failover chain: "model" or "model@provider". Capability-ordered.
export FALLBACK_CHAIN='big-pickle@zen,poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free@cline,moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6@dahl,nemotron-3-ultra-free@zen,mimo-v2.5-free@zen,gemini-3.7-flash@google,agnes-2.5-flash@bynara,stepfun-3.7-flash@bynara'

export MODEL_PROVIDER='{}'
# KNOWN_MODELS — MUST only contain models actually served by a provider above,
# otherwise resolveModel maps unknown->FALLBACK_MODEL and the client-requested
# model (e.g. agnes-2.0-flash) gets routed to zen which 401s "not supported".
# Stale on-served ids removed (agnes-2.0-flash, ling-3.0-flash-free, mistral-medium-3-5).
export KNOWN_MODELS="poolside/laguna-s-2.1:free,thinkingmachines/inkling:free,nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free,cohere/north-mini-code:free,big-pickle,nemotron-3-ultra-free,mimo-v2.5-free,moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6,qwen/qwen3.8-max-free,agnes-2.5-flash,stepfun-3.7-flash,gemini-3-flash-preview,gemini-3.1-flash-lite,gemini-3.5-flash,gemini-3.5-flash-lite,gemini-3.6-flash,gemini-3.7-flash,gemma-4-26b-a4b-it,gemma-4-31b-it,groq/compound-mini,openai/gpt-oss-20b,qwen/qwen3.6-27b,allam-2-7b,groq/compound,openai/gpt-oss-safeguard-20b"
